I will keep my land in the usual wheat-maize rotation. In Quzhou County, this is the steadiest way for me to make sure I have grain and income. I will first manage my winter wheat that is already in the field, then after harvest I will plant summer maize right away. I would choose improved or hybrid seed because I want stable yield and stronger resistance, and I do not want to take chances with weak seed. I will control fertilizer because too much wastes money, but I will still give enough nitrogen for grain filling. I will irrigate a few key times instead of too often, because water matters most at the important growth stages. I will use rotary tillage for convenience and cost, and I will spray only when needed to control the main diseases, insects, and weeds. My goal is steady production with work I can manage myself.
